proposed_widenings.name: shared_magic_item_resource_bundle
proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item composite can combine passive and activated parts, but each activated part owns its own resource and reset cadence. Staff of Power has two distinct activated abilities that share one 20-charge pool, the same dawn recharge, and the same last-charge mishap state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This staff has 20 charges ... While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it ... Regaining Charges. The staff regains 2d8 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn ... Retributive Strike. You can take a Magic action to break the staff

proposed_widenings.name: item_destruction_or_degradation_outcome
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing destruction policy can only model destruction on last-charge depletion. Staff of Power instead has a last-charge roll with partial property loss on 1 and charge recovery on 20, so the post-empty lifecycle is neither simple destruction nor no effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls but loses all other properties. On a 20, the staff regains 1d8 + 2 charges.

notes: I did not author content/magic_item_staff_of_power.dhall because any current encoding would either duplicate the shared charge pool across multiple activation parts or omit a primary mechanic.
